q: Trade to the WNBA enjoyers that makes sense for both parties but greatly improves my team. A steam for me, but what he might still do?
short: Offer Nick (WNBA Enjoyers) Julius Randle plus Mikal Bridges for Devin Booker. You give up two bench players and get a 43.2 FP/game guard, and Nick gets a big man to fill his Porzingis hole.
answer:
The idea: Nick is 0-3 but has a strong core, and his weak spot is size. Kristaps Porzingis (36.9 projected) is OUT and sitting in a lineup slot, Demin is OUT, and his other bigs are Ware (33.8), Gafford (29.3) and Queta (27.2). He is guard heavy: Gilgeous-Alexander, Booker, Murray, White, Daniels, Podziemski, Acuff, Fears.

You have a surplus. Adebayo (39.6), Randle (37.0) and Bridges (32.8) are all on your bench, and Powell (36.0) is OUT on the bench. Meanwhile your UTIL spots are filled by Wiggins (32.0), Rollins (31.9) and Peterson (29.1).

The offer: Randle plus Bridges for Devin Booker (PG/SG, 43.2 projected, 38.6 per game this season). Booker has 4 games this week with 166.9 projected points. Peterson, whom he would replace, has 120.2 projected, so that is about +47 points this week. You lose nothing in your lineup because both Randle and Bridges are on your bench.

Why Nick can say yes: he gets 69.8 projected FP per game for 43.2. Randle (PF) fills the frontcourt hole left by Porzingis immediately, and Bridges is better than his UTIL guards Podziemski (30.8) and Acuff (30.4). It is a 2-for-1, so he needs to drop someone (he has 15 players and no one on IR, so he could also stash Porzingis or Demin on IR if they are eligible). His guard depth makes Booker the easiest star for him to move.

Roster check for you: you have 17 players, 15 active plus 2 on IR (Edwards and Morant), so IR is full. A 2-for-1 sends out two and brings in one, so you finish with 14 active and an open spot for a free agent, for example Nic Claxton (30.3) or Vucevic (30.2). Both are about replacement level (30.2), so only add one if he helps your lineup.

What he might still do: he may say no to losing Booker, since he is 0-3 and may value star power over depth. If so, counter for Amen Thompson (SG/SF, 40.0, 4 games, 153.1 projected this week) or Dejounte Murray (39.0, 151.5 this week) for the same package. Both still upgrade you over Peterson and Wiggins. Do not ask for Gilgeous-Alexander (56.8); he will not move him for this. He could also ask for Adebayo instead of Bridges. I would resist that, since Adebayo is your best bench big and should probably start. He could ask for Allen or Zubac too; only go there if you get Booker.

Side note: your lineup looks off. Adebayo and Randle are on the bench while Peterson and Rollins are in UTIL. Check it before today's games lock. I did not search news for this one, so the injury timelines for Porzingis and Allen (day to day) are not verified. My read on Nick's needs comes from the league data only, and I cannot know what he actually wants.

moves.do: Offer Nick A. (WNBA Enjoyers): Julius Randle + Mikal Bridges for Devin Booker
moves.why: Booker projects 43.2 per game and 166.9 this week versus 120.2 for Peterson, whom he replaces; Randle (37.0) and Bridges (32.8) are bench players for you.

moves.do: Fallback ask: the same package for Amen Thompson (40.0) or Dejounte Murray (39.0)
moves.why: Both project about 152 this week versus 120 for Peterson, roughly +30 for you, and they are easier for Nick to part with.

moves.do: Start Adebayo over a UTIL guard before lineups lock
moves.why: He is on your bench at 39.6 projected, against 29.1 for Peterson.
